marketAnalyst.title: Market Analyst
marketAnalyst.description: Get real-time market price analysis and recommendations. Ask a question like "What is the price of onions in Pune Mandi?"

faqs.q1: What kind of questions can I ask?
faqs.a1: You can ask about current crop prices in specific locations, price trends, and get recommendations on whether to sell or hold your produce. For example: 'What is the price of tomatoes in Pune?' or 'Should I sell my wheat stock now?'
faqs.q2: How accurate is the price information?
faqs.a2: The price information is based on real-time data from various agricultural markets (mandis). While we strive for accuracy, prices can fluctuate rapidly. Use the information as a guide for your decisions.
faqs.q3: Can I ask about future price predictions?
faqs.a3: Yes, you can ask for price trend analysis and predictions. The AI will provide insights based on historical data and current market conditions, but please note that these are forecasts and not guarantees.
faqs.q4: What locations and crops are supported?
faqs.a4: The assistant covers a wide range of major crops and markets across India. You can ask about vegetables, grains, fruits, and more in various cities and their main agricultural markets.

client.placeholder: e.g., What are the chances of tomato prices increasing in the next week in Bangalore? Or click the mic to speak.

about.title: About BeejMantra
about.description: BeejMantra is an AI-powered farming assistant designed to support small-scale Indian farmers with real-time crop diagnosis, mandi prices, government schemes, and personalized farming advice in local languages.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to BeejMantra. We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data in an open and transparent manner. This privacy policy sets out how we collect, use, and protect your information.

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.content: When you register, we collect your name, email, and location to create and manage your account.

usage.title: Usage Data
usage.content: We collect information on how you interact with our services, such as features used and frequency of access.

image.title: Image Data
image.content: For our Crop Doctor feature, we collect images you upload. These are used solely for diagnosis and are not shared with third parties.

useOfInfo.title: How We Use Your Information
useOfInfo.content: We use your information to provide and improve our services, personalize your experience, and communicate with you.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell your personal data. We may share anonymized data with partners for research purposes, but never your personal identifiable information without your consent.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time through your profile settings or by contacting us.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@beejmantra.in.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using BeejMantra, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement.

useOfService.title: Use of Service
useOfService.content: You agree to use our services for lawful purposes only and in a way that does not infringe the rights of, restrict or inhibit anyone else's use and enjoyment of the service.
useOfService.item1: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password.
useOfService.item2: The advice provided by the AI is for informational purposes only and should not be considered a substitute for professional agricultural advice.
useOfService.item3: You must not misuse our services by knowingly introducing viruses or other material that is malicious or technologically harmful.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer of Warranties
disclaimer.content: The service is provided on an 'as is' and 'as available' basis without any warranties of any kind, either express or implied.

limitation.title: Limitation of Liability
limitation.content: In no event shall BeejMantra or its developers be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, including without limitation, loss of profits, data, use, goodwill, or other intangible losses.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: We may terminate or suspend your account immediately, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.content: These Terms shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of India, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

changes.title: Changes
changes.content: We reserve the right, at our sole discretion, to modify or replace these Terms at any time.

faq.title: Common Questions from Farmers
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to everything you need to know about using BeejMantra.
faq.q1: Is BeejMantra completely free for farmers?
faq.a1: Yes, crop disease identification, live mandi prices, weather forecasts, and government scheme navigator are 100% free for all farmers.
faq.q2: If I can't type, can I ask by speaking?
faq.a2: Absolutely! Annapurna AI fully supports voice. Tap the mic button and ask questions in your mother tongue (Hindi, Kannada, Bengali, Bhojpuri, English).
faq.q3: How does Crop Doctor diagnose diseases?
faq.a3: Simply upload a clear photo of the leaf or plant. Google Gemini AI analyzes the symptoms and provides organic as well as chemical remedies instantly.
faq.q4: Where do the Mandi rates come from?
faq.a4: Mandi rates are updated live directly from official Government of India APMC and NCDEX national agricultural market databases.
faq.q5: Can I apply for government schemes here?
faq.a5: Yes, after checking your eligibility in the Schemes section, you get direct links to official portals along with the checklist of required documents.
